cost: For I run/base item entries, C total cells, Q distinct layer/class keys and A varieties, the leak section first collects keys by scanning item maps, then invokes paired once per key per variety and stream. A conservative bound is O(A*Q*(I log(I+1)+C) + K log(K+1)), including base item lookups and sorting K emitted leak rows; key-set insertion adds O(A*C log(Q+1)). The current finite Layer/Class universe bounds Q by a source constant, but repeated item/cell scans remain explicit. Other report sections scan cells/confusion maps and perform ordered lookups; output memory O(rendered bytes+K+Q).
